about: The Secret of the Sixth Sunday after Epiphany in the 1962 Roman Missal, also used when this formulary is resumed after Pentecost. The proper pages print the body and short Per Dominum cue. The full conclusion and Amen are a separate RG115a expansion with declared house orthography.

seg.tr: May this offering, O God, we beseech You, cleanse and renew us, govern and protect us. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: May this offering, O God, we beseech You, cleanse us
